correctness.rationale: PASS: Reconstructed kernel according to longest initial coordinate agreement and mismatch proportions (q-1)/q^j, giving row absolute norm r_n+Σ|r_{k+1}-r_k| with r_{k+1}=r_k/q+(1-1/q)b_k; kernel symmetric so L1 equals Linfinity. Dynamic programming V_t(r) obeys max{c r+V_(t-1)(λr), c(1-r)+V_(t-1)(λr+c)} and reduces by induction to affine candidates crossing only at λ for even remaining depth and c for odd remaining depth (n>=2); c>λ assures rigidity, with depth-one exception. Pairwise bit-interaction expansion and finite geometric sums give exact formulas and slope. Independently enumerated all 2^n masks at q=3..7, n=1..10, computing signed kernel class rows with exact rational fractions and matching every norm, optimizer and parity formula. This finite enumeration corroborates but does not replace the Bellman induction.
